answer: Run one similarity pass at each epoch close, across the whole network rather than per grader. Strip the seed words, digits and ID tags from every accepted answer, then compare it with all answers from the past five epochs, from every address. A farm that word-swaps an old relic onto a fresh key, or dresses one skeleton in violet adjectives across forty heads, surfaces as a family; the family splits a single reward and its members drop back to the probation ledge. Honest authors rarely collide, so the cost lands on templates.
